name: Binance BTC/USDT microprice
description: For each fresh reconstructed Binance level-two book, microprice is (ask times bid size plus bid times ask size) divided by total touch size. microprice_deviation_bps is (microprice minus the book midpoint) divided by that midpoint times 10000, so a positive value indicates touch-size pressure toward the ask. Ready output requires a complete positive uncrossed Binance book no more than 10 seconds old. This identity is single-venue: it reads only Binance inputs and is ready whenever the Binance book is complete, uncrossed, and inside the staleness bound, independently of the other adopted spot venue. The blended `btc.external.*` reading of the same measurement stays the reference layer and continues to require every adopted venue (ADR 0024). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even. Venue port (B1): this identity is the Binance sibling of `btc.coinbase.spot_microprice@1.0.0` and reuses that definition's formulas, windows, thresholds, warm-up, staleness bound, field set, field types and eight-place round-half-to-even rounding verbatim; only the source ids differ (`crates/btc-signals/src/spot_signals.rs`, `crates/btc-signals/src/candidate_spot_signals.rs`). The instrument is Binance spot BTCUSDT; at decision time every price-level field is converted from the venue's USDT quote to USD via the Kraken USDT/USD mid, while ratio fields (basis points, imbalances, ratios, counts) are quote-currency neutral. Binance inputs are rights-gated (`signals/knowledge/RIGHTS-LEDGER.md`): the lane is built and tested to the adopted standard, and its runtime refuses to start unless the environment allow-list `SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES` names `binance`, which the deployment sets only after that row clears. The Binance book input is the `btcusdt@depth20@100ms` partial-depth stream: every message is a complete top-20-per-side image at a 100 ms cadence, not a diff, and it carries no venue clock, so `event_time_basis` is `receipt` and `event_time` is the local receipt time. Ordering is the strictly increasing `last_update_id`; a duplicate or lower id is dropped and never applied. The captured window is 20 levels per side; because the top of book is always present in the image the touch levels this identity reads are always observed, so there is no deviation beyond the receipt time basis. quote_currency is emitted on every decision and is the constant "usd" for this venue: every price-denominated field is converted from the venue's USDT quote to USD via the Kraken USDT/USD mid, while ratio, basis-point, base-size and count fields are quote-currency neutral. E47 (USD quoting): this identity quotes in USD. The venue trades BTC against USDT, so at decision time every price, notional and quote-denominated cost field (microprice, book_midpoint) is converted USDT to USD with the latest USDT/USD reference rate; base-denominated fields (base sizes, counts, basis-point ratios, durations) are unchanged. The reference is kraken.spot.usdt-usd.ticker, delivered on the dedicated Kraken reference socket (a second reference, coinbase.exchange.usdt-usd.ticker, joins when it lands). quote_currency is the constant "usd". usdt_usd_rate (decimal, eight places, round-half-to-even) and usdt_usd_rate_age_ms are published on every ready decision, and the identity is non-ready with reason usdt_reference_stale when the rate is absent or older than 60000 milliseconds.
